column1: # fuzz/corpora.tsv --- where scripts/fuzz-grammars finds each bundled
# grammar's own real sources (E7g). One row per BUILTIN_LANGUAGES entry;
# tests/e7g_grammar_fuzz_acceptance.rs holds the rows to that table and
# each crate@version to Cargo.lock, so adding or bumping a grammar means
# editing this file, and editing it runs the fuzz job.
# kind: `corpus` is a tree-sitter test corpus (headers, source, `---`,
# tree), fetched at `commit`, the commit behind the crate's release tag
# (latex: v0.6.0, the codebook republish 0.6.1 has no tag of its own);
# `files` is real source classified by extension (zig: its grammar ships
# no corpus at any revision, so the Zig standard library at 0.15.1);
# `crate` is files inside the crate's own registry source. lean4 was one
# (arborium ships two samples, not a corpus), which left CI's smoke two
# seeds and twelve mutated inputs (E7g review 1); since E7h.4 it is the
# Lean 4 compiler's own `src/Init` at v4.23.0, real Lean as Zig's standard
